definitions: In Islamic eschatology, the Mahdi is the prophesied redeemer of Islam who will rule for five, seven, or nineteen years (according to various interpretations) before the Day of Judgment and will rid the world of evil and injustice.
A messianic leader who, according to Islamic tradition, will appear before the end of the world to restore justice and religion.
examples: Many Muslims await the coming of the Mahdi.
The Mahdi is believed to be a descendant of Muhammad.
The concept of the Mahdi is significant in Shia Islam.
